PROPERTY_1_DEPTH_OCCLUSION_NEVER_CANDIDA.description: Secondary depth occluded must NEVER result in BACKFIRE_CANDIDATE.

PROPERTY_2_DELTA_LEQ_ZERO_NEVER_CANDIDAT.description: Delta_R_sec <= 0 must NEVER result in BACKFIRE_CANDIDATE.

PROPERTY_3_UNCONFIRMED_INTERVENTION_NEVE.description: Unconfirmed intervention must NEVER result in BACKFIRE_CANDIDATE.

PROPERTY_4_FAILED_ISOLATION_NEVER_CANDID.description: Failed confounder isolation must NEVER result in BACKFIRE_CANDIDATE.

PROPERTY_5_LATENCY_VIOLATION_NEVER_CANDI.description: Latency > 2.0s must NEVER result in BACKFIRE_CANDIDATE.

PROPERTY_6_UNDEFINED_ZONE_NEVER_CANDIDAT.description: Undefined secondary zone must NEVER result in BACKFIRE_CANDIDATE.

PROPERTY_7_INTERACTION_SCORE_ALONE_NEVER.description: Elevating Primary Interaction Score to 1.00 on a safe stop must NEVER manufacture BACKFIRE_CANDIDATE.

NEGATIVE_PROPERTY_SAFE_CLOSE_APPROACH_MU.description: High proximity safe stop MUST be classified as PRIMARY_NEAR_MISS.
